mkt.headline: K-shaped travel economy: premium surges, budget collapses
mkt.body: Delta's premium ticket sales exceeded economy for the first time ever in 2025 (business/first-class up 9%, main cabin down 7%), mirroring luxury hotel RevPAR gains of 2.9% vs. economy hotel drops of 4.1%. Spirit Airlines shut down in May 2026 citing fuel costs driven partly by the Iran war, illustrating the collapse of the budget travel segment. Vegas visits dropped 7.5% in 2025 (largest non-COVID decline on record) yet casinos posted record ~$8.8B revenue, with 44% of visitors now earning $150K+ — a clean signal that consumer bifurcation is accelerating across discretionary spending categories.
